generations.prompt: A Caucasian man in his late 50s with short graying hair and neat goatee sits at a desk in a beige corporate cubicle office with grid-patterned drop ceiling and fluorescent lighting. A calculator tumbles from the desk to the floor with a satisfying thud. Cut to a close-up of a red stapler sitting motionless on the desk, appearing to smirk with comedic menace. The camera captures the action with quick, precise cuts emphasizing the comedic timing. Cool fluorescent lighting creates stark shadows. The sterile greige and off-white office environment frames the absurd moment with documentary-style realism that enhances the deadpan humor.
